I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this small plot. One bag costs too many birr and is more than I need for 0.24 hectares, so I will use cow manure instead, like I always do. I will plant the seed I kept from last year. My family and I will do all the work ourselves — I have no money to pay hired workers.
